title: Seneca
hero_prompt: Wide darkened backdrop, a cracked hourglass at the center with its sand frozen mid-fall, a single oil lamp casting long shadows across a stone writing table covered in open scroll-letters, rendered in a classical Roman fresco or Piranesi etching style — coarse cross-hatching, muted ochre and umber, no colour saturation; the mood is urgent quietude, the light intimate and finite. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem: a stark hourglass silhouette, upper chamber nearly empty, lower full, encircled by a thin laurel ring — black on aged parchment or white on black, woodcut weight, no fine linework, no text, no numerals, must survive at 24px.
